title: Philip K. Dick — Survival, Reproduction, Illusion #Shorts
description:
The bleak reading of Philip K. Dick is also the most testable one. Philip Kindred Dick (December 16, 1928 – March 2, 1982) was an American science fiction short story writer and novelist. He wrote 45 novels and about 121 short stories, most of which appeared in science fiction magazines.

The story Philip K. Dick tells about itself is the last thing to be trusted. This name seems to have been based on his conflation of two related symbols, the Christian ichthys symbol (two intersecting arcs delineating a fish in profile), which the woman was wearing, and the vesica piscis. Dick recounted that as the sun glinted off the gold pendant, the reflection caused the generation of a "pink beam" of light that mesmerized him.
